hints.title: Baseline Uniform Subtraction
hints.text: In k total operations, every number receives at least k * y total subtraction from general reductions.

hints.title: Extra Subtraction Allowance
hints.text: Targeting a number with the main operation yields an extra x - y subtraction beyond the baseline k * y.

hints.title: Boost Feasibility Test
hints.text: For a fixed number of operations k, check whether the total extra boosts required across all numbers is at most k.

hints.title: Binary Search on Operations Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on operation count with linear verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating operations greedily per step takes O(total_ops * n) and TLEs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models operation count monotonically and applies binary search on answer.
